title: draft-upsert response
description: warnings may include SLUG_MISMATCH {wanted, got} (Phase 1 cannot set a slug on create).

idempotentReplay.description: v1.0.1: true on a response replayed from the idempotency store (EmDash strips the X-AOS-Idempotent-Replay header)

draftRevisionId.description: EmDash draft revision id, or v<version> (e.g. v1) for a never-published entry whose main row is the draft. Opaque.

rev.description: Opaque concurrency token: compare for equality only; send back as baseRev
